scripts.//test: THE FLAG IS BACK, AND IT IS NOT REDUNDANT — #792. It was removed by #740 on the reasoning that scripts/test-ceiling.mjs (preloaded from bunfig.toml) now sets the ceiling for every invocation. Measured on bun 1.3.11, it does not: `setDefaultTimeout` from a preload reaches only the FIRST test file a run loads, and every file after it is back on bun's 5 s default. This suite has 182 files, so #740 left 181 of them on 5 s in CI while the preload's own self-report said 20 000 — #414's defect exactly, one layer up. `bun test --timeout N` does span every file, which is why the number lives here again as well. The two are not rivals: the preload reads an explicit `--timeout` back off the operating system and stands aside for it, so this line wins for `bun run test` and the preload still covers the single-file `bun test apps/engine/test/one.test.ts` a person types. `TELAR_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS=N` covers a run that can pass neither, a test's own third-argument ceiling beats all of them, and test/test-ceiling.test.ts asserts each of those claims against a child's own verdict rather than against this sentence. Keep this number equal to TEST_CEILING_MS — scripts/source-invariants.mjs refuses a rival one. The `eventually`/`until` helpers in test/*.test.ts carry the matching 15 s wall-clock bound, so a wait can outlast a loaded runner without outlasting this ceiling.
scripts.//test:bounded: THE RUN THAT CAN SAY IT HUNG — #807. It delegates to `test` above rather than spelling out the command, so the ceiling stays in one place and this never becomes a second opinion about it. What it adds is a wall-clock budget, a group kill that reaches the `bun test` grandchild, a timestamped log under the OS temp dir, and a verdict that tells `hung` (no end-of-run tally, budget exceeded) from `failed` (tally, fail > 0) — which an exit code cannot, since both are non-zero. `bun run test:engine` at the repo root goes through here; `bun run test` in this directory is still the plain run a person types.
scripts.//durability:pragmas: THE ASSERTION THE SUITE CANNOT MAKE — #632. `checkpoint_fullfsync` is 1 by default under bun:sqlite and 0 under node:sqlite, and the .app runs the second; a bun test asserting it is vacuous. This bundles the store the way build-app.sh bundles the engine, runs it under plain node, and asserts the three pragma values. Seconds, and it does not build the app.
